<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def get_slot(fr, r0, r1, c0base, i):
    lines = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    c0=c0base+7*i
    g=[['B' if lines[r][c]=='B' else '.' for c in range(c0,c0+7)] for r in range(r0,r1)]
    rs=[i for i,row in enumerate(g) if 'B' in row]
    cs=[j for row in g for j,ch in enumerate(row) if ch=='B']
    r0b,r1b,c0b,c1b=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    return tuple(tuple('B' if g[i][j]=='B' else '.' for j in range(c0b,c1b+1)) for i in range(r0b,r1b+1))
def show(s): return ' '.join(''.join(r) for r in s)
def dist(a,b):
    if len(a)!=len(b) or len(a[0])!=len(b[0]): return 99
    return sum(1 for i in range(len(a)) for j in range(len(a[0])) if a[i][j]!=b[i][j])
# current cursor at slot0 (col15-19). Move to slot2,3,4 and map cycles.
# First restore slot0 to G0? It's already G0. Move RIGHT to slot1 (A), slot2, slot3, slot4.
init = history[0].frame
pink_init = [get_slot(init,51,58,14,i) for i in range(5)]
blue = [get_slot(init,40,47,14,i) for i in range(5)]
cycles={}
for target in [2,3,4]:
    # move cursor from slot0 to target
    for _ in range(target): action(['RIGHT'])
    g0 = get_slot(current_frame,51,58,14,target)
    seq=[g0]
    for k in range(8):
        action(['UP'])
        if last_action_result.get('game_over') or last_action_result.get('run_complete'): break
        s=get_slot(current_frame,51,58,14,target)
        seq.append(s)
        if s==g0: break
    cycles[target]=seq
    # move back to slot0
    for _ in range(target): action(['LEFT'])
for t in [2,3,4]:
    print("slot",t,"cycle len",len(cycles[t]))
    for s in cycles[t]: print("  ",show(s))
allpink=set()
for t in [2,3,4]: allpink.update(cycles[t])
allpink.update([get_slot(history[0].frame,51,58,14,0),get_slot(history[0].frame,51,58,14,1)])
print("num distinct pink glyphs so far:",len(allpink))
for bi,b in enumerate(blue):
    best=min(allpink,key=lambda p:dist(p,b))
    print("blue",bi,"min dist to pink alphabet:",dist(best,b), show(best))
</parameter>
</function>

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def get_slot(fr, r0, r1, c0base, i):
    lines = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    c0=c0base+7*i
    g=[['B' if lines[r][c]=='B' else '.' for c in range(c0,c0+7)] for r in range(r0,r1)]
    rs=[i for i,row in enumerate(g) if 'B' in row]
    cs=[j for row in g for j,ch in enumerate(row) if ch=='B']
    r0b,r1b,c0b,c1b=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    return tuple(tuple('B' if g[i][j]=='B' else '.' for j in range(c0b,c1b+1)) for i in range(r0b,r1b+1))
def show(s): return ' '.join(''.join(r) for r in s)
def dist(a,b):
    if len(a)!=len(b) or len(a[0])!=len(b[0]): return 99
    return sum(1 for i in range(len(a)) for j in range(len(a[0])) if a[i][j]!=b[i][j])
# current cursor at slot0 (col15-19). Move to slot2,3,4 and map cycles.
# First restore slot0 to G0? It's already G0. Move RIGHT to slot1 (A), slot2, slot3, slot4.
init = history[0].frame
pink_init = [get_slot(init,51,58,14,i) for i in range(5)]
blue = [get_slot(init,40,47,14,i) for i in range(5)]
cycles={}
for target in [2,3,4]:
    # move cursor from slot0 to target
    for _ in range(target): action(['RIGHT'])
    g0 = get_slot(current_frame,51,58,14,target)
    seq=[g0]
    for k in range(8):
        action(['UP'])
        if last_action_result.get('game_over') or last_action_result.get('run_complete'): break
        s=get_slot(current_frame,51,58,14,target)
        seq.append(s)
        if s==g0: break
    cycles[target]=seq
    # move back to slot0
    for _ in range(target): action(['LEFT'])
for t in [2,3,4]:
    print("slot",t,"cycle len",len(cycles[t]))
    for s in cycles[t]: print("  ",show(s))
allpink=set()
for t in [2,3,4]: allpink.update(cycles[t])
allpink.update([get_slot(history[0].frame,51,58,14,0),get_slot(history[0].frame,51,58,14,1)])
print("num distinct pink glyphs so far:",len(allpink))
for bi,b in enumerate(blue):
    best=min(allpink,key=lambda p:dist(p,b))
    print("blue",bi,"min dist to pink alphabet:",dist(best,b), show(best))
